name: Chin Chiang-class patrol ship (PGG), Republic of China Navy

published.source: the game's own row (warship_specs.js): 61.4 x 9.5 m; the en.wikipedia page answered HTTP 429 when the model was built (see the js/hero/roc_ships2.js header)

references.name: [C1] PGG-606 starboard broadside at sea (2019), from a quay a little above the deck
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'PGG-606右側.jpg' (the [C1] of js/hero/roc_ships2.js), 1280 x 853 thumb
references.note: scaled on the published 61.4 m: transom ~x 150 px to stem head ~x 1160 px (1010 px). Taken from a little above the deck, so heights foreshorten and the far side shows: kept as a quarter view for the reviewer and overlay only, not gated. The 2019 fit shows the after dome tower abaft the racks, which the e90 model leaves out ([C2] 2010 has none). Hull number and flag on the photo are not part of the spec. Overlay origin: the transom's waterline corner at about px (130, 555), +-1.5 m (the elevated view and the wake hide it). The radome lattice tower at about x -11 on this photo is the 2019 after dome tower (not drawn, see not_confirmed).

must_show: a monohull 61.4 m long with a raked stem (forefoot at d 58.4, x +27.7) and a flat transom at x -30.7; deck 2.85 m aft rising to 4.4 m at the stem head [C1]
the two-tier deckhouse d 15.8 .. 47.1 (x -14.9 .. +16.4), roofs 7.9 - 8.1 m, half-width 3.6, with the raked bridge face at its forward end (foot x +16.4, roof edge x +15.5) and its window band [C1]
the raised louvred block d 26.1 .. 33.4 (x -4.6 .. +2.7), roof 10.6 m, its louvres on both sides at z 8.6 .. 10.2 [C1]
the main lattice mast with legs on the roof at d 32.8 .. 36.5 (centre x +4.0), platform at 14.7 m, yards at 16.8 and 18.2 m, the pole to 19.5 m [C1][C2]
the two small radomes on posts over the bridge at d 39.6 (y +1.0) and d 42.2 (y -1.0), tops about 10.4 m [C1][C2]
the Hsiung Feng box racks abaft the house, two stacks of two boxes each side (y +-1.2 and +-2.35), after ends at d 10.2 (x -20.5), rising forward 34 deg [C1]
the 40 mm gun in its round cupola on the forecastle, ring at d 50.3 (x +19.6), the trained 'turret' node [C1][C2]

deck-edge rails on stanchions fore and aft of the house (x -30.4 .. -15.2 and +16.7 .. +30.1), rails round the three roofs and the mast platform, life rings at d 17.4 and 44.2 on the house sides and raft canisters on the after roof at d 18.6 and 22.4; plain haze grey, no hull number [C1][C2]

landmarks.name: lower box rack after end
landmarks.note: [C1] the lower boxes' after ends at d 10.2 (the upper boxes stand 0.55 m further aft, stacked square on them); whole triangles under z 4.0: the box's foot (its end face is square to its 34 deg axis, so its top corner stands 0.55 m further aft)

not_confirmed: the one stored reference [C1] is a slightly elevated broadside (perspective): no exact outline is gated; the stations are read off it at 16.45 px/m (+-0.3 m in length, more in height)

the house half-width (3.6 m) from bow views only; shafts, screws and rudders (two each, drawn plainly); the canister count per rack; the 1990s Hsiung Feng I fit (drawn as [C1] shows the racks in 2019); the after radar tower of [C1] is NOT drawn ([C2] 2010 has none)
